title: The Petition That Had To Travel
stage_contract: Collect document only after Bes actually acknowledges petition
Hand copy to Mera in Saltwake personally
Return after a later in-world day and take Mera's reply personally
Deliver reply to Orrel in the Crossings personally

confidential.tension: Mera protects privacy but fears the private ledger will be ignored

redacted_public.tension: Mera supports documenting arrears but questions the harm from public pressure

scene_cues.shot: Traveler physically lifts copy; camera preserves privacy seal
scene_cues.subtitle: A petition does not walk by itself.

scene_cues.shot: Two people face one another at the local courier's actual station
scene_cues.subtitle: It is not my consent to lend again.

scene_cues.shot: Same woman, new day, returns signed reply to the traveler
scene_cues.subtitle: I have had a morning to disagree.

scene_cues.shot: Orrel physically receives and examines the reply
scene_cues.sound: river beneath a worked stone bridge
scene_cues.subtitle: A record has arrived. The debt has not vanished.
